snippet.title: Cho Noi - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Cho Noi on Steam! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3644880/Cho_Noi/

Cho Noi is a digital board game like Monopoly and Dokapon where you fight inanimate objects and sell its remains to unsuspecting shoppers – on boats.

Players move around the board via dice to gather collectable stamps, fight enemies for goods, and build storefronts to sell gained goods. Take down other merchants by any means necessary to rack up the most coins in the whole market!
